_comment: Copy this file, rename it to <dataset_id>.json, and fill in every field before adding real data under datasets/raw/<category>/. build_manifest.py aggregates every *.json file in this directory (except this template) into datasets/metadata/dataset_manifest.json. See scripts/dataset/schemas.py:DatasetSource for the authoritative field list/types.
name: Example Public Dataset
license: e.g. CC-BY-4.0 — copy the exact license name from the source
collection_conditions: Describe known conditions (e.g. camera-trap, citizen-science submissions), or 'unknown'
collection_method: How the source collected this data originally
usage_restrictions: Any restriction beyond the license itself, e.g. 'non-commercial only', or null
